HINGE MOVED. The 07-20 hinge was the post-David-Simon succession, and two quarters of accelerating NOI/FFO, two guide raises, an intact buyback and an intact "at least 3%" discipline have substantially retired it. The thesis now hinges on DURABILITY VERSUS THE 2027 SETUP: whether the 2026 acceleration is a re-based earnings algorithm or a favorable cycle plus an acquisition comp — because ~120bps of the 8.5% domestic NOI growth is the TRG 12% buy-in and management says "that it goes away in the next 2 quarters", management's own multi-year frame is unchanged at "we've grown NOI 4-plus percent
